### Astrobiologia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[astrobiology.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/astrobiology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Scientific investigation of the possibility, conditions and evidence of life beyond Earth, including chemical origins, habitability and contamination risks. The methods of spacecraft observation are classified with astronomical instrumentation and evidence rather than presented as a separate astrobiological subject.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora cosa potrebbe essere necessario alla vita oltre la Terra e come gli scienziati potrebbero riconoscerne prove attendibili.

#### Condizioni per la vita

Skills: 4

[conditionsForLife.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/conditionsForLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluating environments for life requires explicit biological and geochemical assumptions; familiar Earth conditions are useful evidence, not universal proof.

**User-friendly description (it):** Considera gli ambienti e i processi chimici che potrebbero permettere l'esistenza della vita.

##### Analoghi estremofili

[extremophileAnalogues.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/extremophileAnalogues.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret how Earth organisms in extreme environments inform hypotheses about extraterrestrial habitats without proving life exists there.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa la sopravvivenza della vita in ambienti estremi sulla Terra per studiare possibili habitat extraterrestri.

##### Abitabilità

[habitability.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/habitability.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate energy sources, chemical building blocks, solvent availability and environmental stability as possible prerequisites for known life.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come energia, sostanze chimiche, liquidi e condizioni stabili potrebbero rendere un ambiente adatto alla vita.

##### Evoluzione dell'abitabilità nel tempo

[habitabilityThroughTime.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/habitabilityThroughTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess how a world's environmental history may change its potential to support life.

**User-friendly description (it):** Indaga come i cambiamenti ambientali di un mondo influenzano la sua capacità potenziale di ospitare la vita.

##### Chimica prebiotica

[prebioticChemistry.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/conditionsForLife/skills/prebioticChemistry.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain plausible nonliving chemical pathways relevant to life's origins while distinguishing hypotheses from established histories.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come processi chimici non biologici potrebbero produrre ingredienti importanti per l'origine della vita.

#### Prove della vita

Skills: 5

[evidenceOfLife.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/evidenceOfLife.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A proposed sign of life must be weighed against nonbiological processes and the limits of the measuring instrument.

**User-friendly description (it):** Impara a distinguere i possibili segni di vita dalle spiegazioni basate su processi non biologici.

[abioticFalsePositives.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/abioticFalsePositives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify nonbiological processes capable of producing signals superficially similar to biosignatures.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come processi non biologici possano imitare segni che sembrano indicare la vita.

##### Biofirme

[biosignatures.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/biosignatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate chemical, morphological or other candidate indicators that might be produced by living systems.

[lifeDetectionEvidenceStandards.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/lifeDetectionEvidenceStandards.data.ts)

[planetaryProtection.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/planetaryProtection.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why forward and backward biological contamination controls matter for mission science and credible life-detection results.

[technosignatures.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/evidenceOfLife/skills/technosignatures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret possible observable indicators of technology without confusing an unexplained signal with confirmed intelligence.

[subsurfaceHabitats.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astrobiology/searchEnvironments/skills/subsurfaceHabitats.data.ts)

### Strumenti e prove astronomiche

Groups: 6 · Skills: 30

[astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Astronomy infers properties of remote objects from electromagnetic radiation, gravitational effects, particles and spacecraft observations. This domain covers what an observation can reveal, how instruments and methods constrain the evidence, and how competing interpretations are evaluated, not the engineering construction of observatories and spacecraft.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come gli astronomi raccolgono prove attraverso luce, gravità, particelle e missioni spaziali per studiare mondi lontani.

#### Spettri astronomici

Skills: 5

[astronomicalSpectra.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/astronomicalSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Light encodes information about temperature, composition and motion through its distribution across wavelength and the signatures imprinted by matter.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come la scomposizione della luce in lunghezze d'onda rivela le proprietà di oggetti lontani.

[absorptionSpectralLines.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/absorptionSpectralLines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret dark spectral features produced by matter absorbing characteristic wavelengths from background radiation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci nelle righe scure dello spettro indizi sui materiali che assorbono la luce.

[continuousSpectra.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/continuousSpectra.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer broad thermal properties from the distribution of emitted light across wavelengths while recognizing idealized blackbody assumptions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa uno spettro continuo per studiare la temperatura di un oggetto e la luce che emette.

[dopplerShift.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/dopplerShift.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa gli spostamenti delle lunghezze d'onda per studiare il moto verso un osservatore o in direzione opposta.

[emissionSpectralLines.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/emissionSpectralLines.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret discrete bright features produced by matter radiating at characteristic wavelengths.

[multiwavelengthObservation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/astronomicalSpectra/skills/multiwavelengthObservation.data.ts)

#### Indagini gravitazionali e con particelle

Skills: 4

[gravitationalAndParticleProbes.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/astronomicalInstrumentsAndEvidence/gravitationalAndParticleProbes/gravitationalAndParticleProbes.data.ts)

### Meccanica celeste

[celestialMechanics.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/celestialMechanics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational interactions produce trajectories governed by mass, initial conditions and the reference frame in which motion is described.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come la gravità governa il movimento dei corpi celesti.

##### Moto baricentrico

[barycentricMotion.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/barycentricMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why interacting celestial bodies orbit a shared center of mass rather than one body always remaining stationary.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi perché due corpi in orbita si muovono intorno a un centro di massa comune.

##### Prima legge di Keplero

[keplersFirstLaw.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersFirstLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the elliptical-orbit relation, with the central gravitating body at one focus in the idealized two-body model, to the geometry of bound orbits.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci come un'orbita ideale possa seguire un'ellisse con il corpo centrale in uno dei fuochi.

##### Seconda legge di Keplero

[keplersSecondLaw.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersSecondLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the equal-areas-in-equal-times relation to explain variation in orbital speed as an orbiting body changes its distance from the central focus.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega perché un corpo in orbita si muove più velocemente quando è vicino al corpo centrale.

##### Terza legge di Keplero

[keplersThirdLaw.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/keplersThirdLaw.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the square of orbital period to the cube of semi-major axis with the appropriate gravitational mass dependence and limitations of the two-body model.

**User-friendly description (it):** Metti in relazione il periodo orbitale di un oggetto con le dimensioni della sua orbita e la massa gravitante.

##### Energia orbitale

[orbitalEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/orbitalEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate gravitational potential and kinetic energy to bound and unbound orbital trajectories.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come l'energia determina se un'orbita rimane legata o permette la fuga.

##### Gravitazione universale

[universalGravitation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/gravitationalMotion/skills/universalGravitation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the dependence of gravitational attraction on interacting masses and separation to astronomical situations.

**User-friendly description (it):** Ragiona sull'attrazione gravitazionale considerando le masse e le distanze tra gli oggetti.

#### Orbite e rotazioni

Skills: 5

[orbitsAndRotations.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/orbitsAndRotations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Orbital shapes and body orientations are specified through distinct physical parameters that affect long-term celestial behavior.

**User-friendly description (it):** Descrivi e confronta forme, periodi e orientamenti dei moti celesti.

##### Rotazione assiale

[axialRotation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialRotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the spin of a world about its axis, including rotation period and direction, independently of the tilt or precession of that axis.

**User-friendly description (it):** Descrivi la rotazione di un corpo celeste intorno al proprio asse.

##### Inclinazione assiale

[axialTilt.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/axialTilt.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the angle between a body's spin axis and orbital reference direction and explain its influence on illumination geometry and seasons.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come l'inclinazione dell'asse di un mondo modifichi la distribuzione dell'illuminazione.

##### Elementi orbitali

[orbitalElements.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/orbitalElements.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret inclination, eccentricity and other orbital descriptors when comparing celestial trajectories.

**User-friendly description (it):** Leggi i parametri che descrivono la forma e l'orientamento di un'orbita.

##### Periodi orbitali

[orbitalPeriods.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/orbitalPeriods.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the time needed to complete an orbit and compare sidereal and synodic periods, distinguishing orbital revolution from rotation about the body's own axis.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui il tempo necessario a compiere un'orbita attorno a un altro corpo da quello necessario a ruotare sul proprio asse.

##### Rotazione sincrona

[synchronousRotation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/celestialMechanics/orbitsAndRotations/skills/synchronousRotation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how spin–orbit coupling can produce a repeating orientation toward an orbital partner.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega perché alcuni mondi mostrano quasi sempre la stessa faccia al corpo attorno a cui orbitano.

### Oggetti cosmici

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[cosmicObjects.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/cosmicObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** An overview of what kinds of physical objects and extended structures exist beyond Earth and how they are identified and organized. It teaches classification across cosmic scales and distinguishes an object's physical nature from its environment or apparent visual form; detailed physics belongs to the specialized planetary, stellar, galactic and cosmological domains.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i diversi tipi di oggetti e strutture presenti nell'universo e scopri come gli astronomi li classificano.

#### Famiglie di oggetti

Skills: 4

[objectFamilies.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/objectFamilies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classification of astronomical entities requires more than their appearance in a photograph: a point source, a diffuse cloud, a cluster and an extended galaxy may be distinguished by physical evidence and scale.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come gli astronomi identificano i diversi tipi di oggetti attraverso prove fisiche, non soltanto dall'aspetto.

##### Classificazione degli oggetti celesti

[celestialObjectClassification.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/celestialObjectClassification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify astronomical sources as stellar bodies, planetary bodies, compact remnants, diffuse clouds, star clusters, galaxies or other broad physical types using characteristic evidence rather than appearance alone.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le principali categorie di oggetti celesti in base alle loro proprietà fisiche.

##### Oggetti diffusi e compositi

[diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/diffuseAndCompositeObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate diffuse nebulae, gravitationally associated groups and composite galaxies by their constituents, structure and binding rather than surface resemblance.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui nubi di gas, gruppi stellari e galassie in base a ciò che contengono e a come sono organizzati.

##### Oggetti e fenomeni

[objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/objectsAndPhenomena.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish enduring physical objects and systems from observed events or effects such as eclipses, meteors, flares and transient brightenings, even when both occur in object catalogs.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui un oggetto celeste duraturo da un evento come un'eclissi o un brillamento.

##### Confini tra stelle, oggetti substellari e pianeti

[stellarSubstellarAndPlanetaryBoundaries.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/objectFamilies/skills/stellarSubstellarAndPlanetaryBoundaries.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare physically distinct stars, brown dwarfs and planetary-mass bodies using fusion and mass constraints while acknowledging uncertainties near classification boundaries.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora le differenze tra stelle, nane brune e pianeti, comprese le zone di confine tra queste categorie.

#### Organizzazione e appartenenza

Skills: 3

[organizationAndMembership.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/organizationAndMembership.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A body's membership in a system is a different property from its type; the same class of object can be gravitationally bound, ejected or found in a sparse galactic environment.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come gli oggetti fanno parte di sistemi astronomici più grandi oppure si muovono indipendentemente.

##### Pianeti erranti

[freeFloatingPlanets.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/freeFloatingPlanets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain planetary-mass objects not gravitationally bound to a host star, including proposed ejection or isolated-formation origins and detection by microlensing or thermal infrared emission; distinguish low illumination from a complete absence of radiation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come possono formarsi e muoversi i pianeti senza una stella ospite e come è possibile individuarli.

##### Sistemi legati gravitazionalmente

[gravitationallyBoundSystems.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/gravitationallyBoundSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish satellite systems, planetary systems, multiple stars, star clusters, galaxies and galaxy clusters by physical membership and characteristic scales.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta sistemi planetari, ammassi stellari, galassie e altri sistemi tenuti insieme dalla gravità.

##### Appartenenza e isolamento degli oggetti

[objectMembershipAndIsolation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmicObjects/organizationAndMembership/skills/objectMembershipAndIsolation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether an astronomical object is a member of a larger bound system or is apparently isolated, and explain why gravitational context does not by itself determine intrinsic object type.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri se un oggetto appartiene a un sistema più grande, senza confondere tale appartenenza con il suo tipo.

### Cosmologia

Groups: 5 · Skills: 17

[cosmology.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Cosmology tests models for the Universe's large-scale composition, history and expansion using observations with known horizons and uncertainties. Unresolved questions must remain distinguishable from established evidence.

**User-friendly description (it):** Indaga l'espansione, la storia e la struttura su grande scala dell'universo usando prove astronomiche.

#### Componenti cosmiche e vincoli osservativi

Skills: 3

[cosmicComponentsAndConstraints.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Gravitational and expansion measurements constrain otherwise unseen components, while cosmological parameters and theoretical uncertainties limit the interpretations that can be supported by available evidence.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come le misurazioni cosmiche indicano componenti e interrogativi che non sappiamo ancora spiegare completamente.

##### Prove dell'energia oscura

[darkEnergyEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/darkEnergyEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why observations of accelerated expansion motivate a dark-energy component or changes to gravitational models.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esamina le prove che l'espansione dell'universo stia accelerando.

##### Prove della materia oscura

[darkMatterEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/darkMatterEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret dynamical, lensing and cosmological evidence for unseen gravitating mass while recognizing remaining theoretical alternatives.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora perché gli astronomi deducono l'esistenza di materia invisibile dalle prove gravitazionali.

##### Limiti della conoscenza cosmologica

[limitsOfCosmologicalKnowledge.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicComponentsAndConstraints/skills/limitsOfCosmologicalKnowledge.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish empirical constraints from open problems concerning early conditions, dark components and the global extent of the Universe.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui ciò che le osservazioni dimostrano sull'universo dalle principali domande ancora aperte.

#### Espansione cosmica

Skills: 4

[cosmicExpansion.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/cosmicExpansion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Large-scale redshift patterns support an evolving cosmic geometry, not an ordinary explosion into pre-existing empty space.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri cosa rivelano le osservazioni sull'espansione dell'universo.

##### Modelli cosmologici

[cosmologicalModels.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/cosmologicalModels.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the predictions and assumptions of simplified expanding-Universe models against observations.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta i modelli dell'espansione cosmica esaminandone ipotesi e previsioni.

##### Spostamento verso il rosso cosmologico

[cosmologicalRedshift.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/cosmologicalRedshift.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain wavelength stretching associated with the expansion of space, distinguishing it from local Doppler motion.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come l'espansione dello spazio allunga le lunghezze d'onda della luce che viaggia.

##### Espansione e sistemi legati

[expansionVersusBoundSystems.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/expansionVersusBoundSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why the expansion of the Universe does not automatically enlarge gravitationally bound local systems.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri perché l'espansione dello spazio non allontana semplicemente tra loro pianeti, stelle o galassie.

##### Relazione di Hubble–Lemaître

[hubbleLemaitreRelation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicExpansion/skills/hubbleLemaitreRelation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate galaxy recession measurements and distance to empirical evidence for expansion within its domain of applicability.

**User-friendly description (it):** Collega le distanze misurate delle galassie e i loro spostamenti verso il rosso alle prove dell'espansione cosmica.

#### Scale cosmiche

Skills: 4

[cosmicScales.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/cosmicScales.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distances and times become linked by the finite speed of light, which limits how much of the Universe can be observed.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora le immense distanze e i lunghissimi intervalli di tempo coinvolti nell'osservazione del cosmo.

##### Misure delle distanze cosmiche

[cosmicDistanceMeasures.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/cosmicDistanceMeasures.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common cosmological distance concepts when relating observed brightness, redshift and scale.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta i diversi modi con cui i cosmologi definiscono e misurano le distanze.

##### Orizzonti cosmologici

[cosmicHorizons.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/cosmicHorizons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret limits on observable or causally connected regions without treating them as physical walls.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i limiti della distanza da cui i segnali possono raggiungerci o influenzare altre regioni.

##### Tempo di lookback

[lookbackTime.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/lookbackTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why distant observations show objects at earlier cosmic epochs.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri perché osservare più lontano nello spazio significa anche guardare più indietro nel tempo.

##### Universo osservabile

[observableUniverse.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicScales/skills/observableUniverse.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the observable region set by signal travel and cosmic history from claims about the entire Universe.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi perché l'universo osservabile non coincide necessariamente con l'intero universo.

#### Struttura ed evoluzione cosmica

Skills: 2

[cosmicStructureAndEvolution.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/cosmicStructureAndEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Density perturbations, gravity and cosmic expansion shape the cosmic web over time. This branch focuses on spatial organization and dynamical evolution, as distinct from the initial hot state or the physical nature of the Universe's dark components.

**User-friendly description (it):** Indaga come la gravità organizza la materia in grandi strutture nel corso della storia cosmica.

##### Formazione delle strutture cosmiche

[cosmicStructureFormation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/skills/cosmicStructureFormation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how initially small matter-density differences grow into galaxies and large-scale structure.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come minuscole differenze iniziali nella densità della materia hanno prodotto le strutture cosmiche.

##### Ragnatela cosmica

[cosmicWeb.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/cosmicStructureAndEvolution/skills/cosmicWeb.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how filaments, clusters and voids trace the large-scale distribution of matter.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora l'immensa rete di filamenti galattici, ammassi e regioni vuote.

#### Modelli e prove dell'universo primordiale

Skills: 4

[earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The early hot and dense Universe is reconstructed from relic radiation, primordial abundances and theoretical models whose predictions and evidence have different degrees of support.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora le prove usate per ricostruire l'universo primordiale, caldo e denso.

##### Inflazione cosmica

[cosmicInflation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/cosmicInflation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the hypothesized early accelerated-expansion phase, distinguish its predicted consequences from direct observation and evaluate what existing cosmic evidence can and cannot establish.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora l'ipotesi dell'inflazione cosmica, distinguendo le previsioni dalle prove confermate.

##### Radiazione cosmica di fondo a microonde

[cosmicMicrowaveBackground.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/cosmicMicrowaveBackground.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret relic microwave radiation and its spatial variations as evidence about the early Universe.

**User-friendly description (it):** Indaga la debole radiazione a microonde rimasta dall'universo primordiale.

##### Modello del Big Bang caldo

[hotBigBangModel.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/hotBigBangModel.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the evidence-supported early evolution of the observable Universe without claiming that the model fully explains its ultimate origin.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri cosa spiega il modello del Big Bang caldo e cosa non può stabilire.

##### Nucleosintesi primordiale

[primordialNucleosynthesis.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/cosmology/earlyUniverseModelsAndEvidence/skills/primordialNucleosynthesis.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the predicted formation of light nuclei and why their observed abundances test early-Universe models.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come i modelli dell'universo primordiale prevedono le quantità degli elementi leggeri.

### Terra, Luna e Sole

Groups: 4 · Skills: 14

[earthMoonAndSun.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonAndSun.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Here the distinctive geometry of Earth's viewpoint, rotation and revolution produces observable cycles. The scientific emphasis is on explaining familiar sky events from physical arrangements rather than on general geography or atmospheric meteorology.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come movimenti e posizioni di Terra, Luna e Sole creano configurazioni familiari nel cielo.

#### Interazioni Terra–Luna

Skills: 3

[earthMoonInteractions.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/earthMoonInteractions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Earth–Moon system is a long-term dynamical pair whose interactions create measurable effects on Earth and its satellite.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come Terra e Luna si influenzano reciprocamente attraverso la gravità.

##### Orbita lunare e mese

[lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarOrbitAndMonth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the Moon's orbital cycle from the phase cycle by considering Earth's simultaneous revolution around the Sun.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta il percorso della Luna attorno alla Terra con il ciclo ricorrente delle sue fasi.

##### Evoluzione mareale del sistema Terra–Luna

[lunarTidalEvolution.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/lunarTidalEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how tidal dissipation affects Earth's rotation and the Moon's orbital distance over long timescales.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come le interazioni di marea modificano lentamente la rotazione terrestre e l'orbita della Luna.

##### Maree oceaniche

[oceanTides.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/earthMoonInteractions/skills/oceanTides.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the dominant lunar and solar gravitational contributions to periodic changes in sea level, distinguishing ideal equilibrium tides from local coastal conditions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come Luna e Sole contribuiscono a generare le maree degli oceani.

#### Eclissi e allineamenti

Skills: 3

[eclipsesAndAlignments.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/eclipsesAndAlignments.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Occultation and shadow phenomena depend on an observer's line of sight and the relative positions and apparent sizes of bodies.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come le eclissi dipendono dall'allineamento degli oggetti celesti e dalle loro ombre.

##### Stagioni delle eclissi

[eclipseSeasons.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/eclipseSeasons.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why solar and lunar eclipses are not observed at every new or full Moon, using orbital inclination and alignment.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri perché non ogni Luna nuova o piena provoca un'eclissi.

##### Eclissi lunari

[lunarEclipses.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/lunarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions and stages of a lunar eclipse as the Moon encounters Earth's shadow.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come, durante un'eclissi lunare, la Terra proietta la propria ombra sulla Luna.

##### Eclissi solari

[solarEclipses.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/eclipsesAndAlignments/skills/solarEclipses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions, shadow regions and different observational appearances of a solar eclipse.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega quando avviene un'eclissi solare e perché il suo aspetto varia a seconda del luogo.

#### Aspetto della Luna

Skills: 4

[lunarAppearance.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/lunarAppearance.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Moon's changing appearance follows its illumination and orbital viewing geometry, not changes to its intrinsic light production.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come il moto della Luna e la luce solare modificano ciò che vediamo dalla Terra.

##### Librazione lunare

[lunarLibration.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarLibration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why changing perspective exposes slightly different portions of the lunar surface over time.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri perché, con il passare del tempo, diventano visibili porzioni leggermente diverse della Luna.

##### Moto lunare

[lunarMotion.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Trace the Moon's changing position against background stars across successive nights.

**User-friendly description (it):** Segui come cambia la posizione della Luna rispetto alle stelle da una notte all'altra.

##### Fasi lunari

[lunarPhases.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/lunarPhases.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the repeating illuminated shapes visible from Earth through the Sun–Moon–observer geometry.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega come cambia nel tempo la parte illuminata della Luna visibile dalla Terra.

##### Emisferi lunari vicino e lontano

[nearAndFarLunarHemispheres.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/lunarAppearance/skills/nearAndFarLunarHemispheres.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the hemisphere generally facing Earth from the opposite hemisphere without equating the far side with permanent darkness.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi perché la faccia nascosta della Luna non è sempre al buio.

#### Cicli celesti terrestri

Skills: 4

[terrestrialSkyCycles.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/terrestrialSkyCycles/terrestrialSkyCycles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Earth's orientation with respect to sunlight generates daily and annual changes in the visible sky and the duration of daylight.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come rotazione e inclinazione della Terra determinano la durata del giorno e i cambiamenti stagionali.

##### Giorno e notte

[dayAndNight.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/earthMoonAndSun/terrestrialSkyCycles/skills/dayAndNight.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the alternation of illumination and darkness through Earth's rotation rather than the Sun physically circling Earth.

### Sistemi esoplanetari

**Methodological description (English):** Planetary systems beyond the Sun provide evidence about the diversity of worlds and formation outcomes. Detection, physical inference and habitability are separated to avoid treating an apparent signal as proof of a specific environment.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i pianeti oltre il Sistema solare e cosa rivelano le loro scoperte sugli altri sistemi planetari.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa le regioni delle costellazioni per localizzare gli oggetti senza supporre che le loro stelle siano vicine nello spazio.

##### Moto apparente diurno del cielo

[dailySkyMotion.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/observingTheSky/skyPatterns/skills/dailySkyMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the apparent east-to-west paths of celestial objects across the sky, including circumpolar paths.

**User-friendly description (it):** Descrivi come sembrano spostarsi le stelle attraverso il cielo nel corso del giorno o della notte.

##### Visibilità stagionale del cielo

[seasonalSkyVisibility.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/observingTheSky/skyPatterns/skills/seasonalSkyVisibility.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why different stars and constellations become visible at different times of the year.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega perché in stagioni diverse sono visibili configurazioni stellari differenti.

##### Moto proprio stellare

[stellarProperMotion.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/observingTheSky/skyPatterns/skills/stellarProperMotion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the slow positional motion of a star relative to distant background sources and distinguish this physical change from the daily apparent rotation of the sky.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci il lentissimo spostamento di una stella rispetto ad altre stelle più lontane.

### Scienze planetarie

Groups: 4 · Skills: 18

[planetaryScience.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryScience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Planetary science compares worlds by their surfaces, interiors, atmospheres and volatile materials. It uses Earth as one comparative case, but its categories also apply to moons, dwarf planets and worlds beyond the Solar System.

**User-friendly description (it):** Indaga di cosa sono fatti i mondi e come funzionano le loro superfici, atmosfere e strutture interne.

#### Atmosfere e fenomeni meteorologici

Skills: 4

[atmospheresAndWeather.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/atmospheresAndWeather.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Atmospheric behavior depends on composition, gravity, radiation, pressure and circulation in ways that vary widely from Earth.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri perché pianeti diversi hanno atmosfere e condizioni meteorologiche molto differenti.

##### Circolazione atmosferica

[atmosphericCirculation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/skills/atmosphericCirculation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate global winds and thermal patterns to solar input, rotation and atmospheric structure.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come la rotazione e il riscaldamento di un pianeta determinano i grandi movimenti dell'aria.

##### Ritenzione e fuga atmosferica

[atmosphericRetentionAndEscape.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/skills/atmosphericRetentionAndEscape.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how gravity, temperature and escape processes influence the presence or loss of planetary atmospheres.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega perché alcuni mondi conservano atmosfere dense mentre altri perdono gas nello spazio.

##### Effetti serra planetari

[planetaryGreenhouseEffects.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/skills/planetaryGreenhouseEffects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how atmospheric absorption and emission influence surface or atmospheric temperatures on different worlds.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come i gas atmosferici trattengono e rilasciano calore su pianeti diversi.

##### Meteorologia planetaria

[planetaryWeather.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/atmospheresAndWeather/skills/planetaryWeather.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify and interpret weather phenomena such as storms, clouds and winds under non-Earth conditions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci tempeste, venti e nubi su mondi con condizioni diverse da quelle terrestri.

#### Interni planetari e sostanze volatili

Skills: 5

[interiorsAndVolatiles.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/interiorsAndVolatiles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Indirect observations of magnetic fields, heat and fluid materials constrain unseen layers and possible activity beneath planetary surfaces.

**User-friendly description (it):** Indaga gli strati nascosti dei pianeti, i campi magnetici, l'acqua e il ghiaccio.

##### Criovulcanismo

[cryovolcanism.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/cryovolcanism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize and explain eruptions driven by volatile liquids and ices rather than molten rock.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come i mondi freddi possano eruttare materiali ghiacciati o volatili invece di rocce fuse.

##### Struttura interna planetaria

[planetaryInteriorStructure.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/planetaryInteriorStructure.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer cores, mantles or other layers from density, seismic, magnetic and gravitational evidence.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa prove indirette per esplorare il nucleo e gli strati interni di un pianeta.

##### Campi magnetici planetari

[planetaryMagneticFields.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/planetaryMagneticFields.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conditions under which internal conductive flows can generate global or regional magnetic fields.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega come il movimento di materiali conduttori all'interno di un pianeta possa generare un campo magnetico.

##### Oceani sotterranei

[subsurfaceOceans.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/subsurfaceOceans.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret geophysical and compositional evidence for liquids beneath icy surfaces without assuming biology.

**User-friendly description (it):** Indaga gli indizi secondo cui alcune lune ghiacciate potrebbero nascondere oceani liquidi.

##### Acqua e ghiaccio oltre la Terra

[waterAndIceBeyondEarth.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/interiorsAndVolatiles/skills/waterAndIceBeyondEarth.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the physical states and likely reservoirs of water on different Solar System bodies.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora dove possono trovarsi acqua e ghiaccio su altri mondi.

#### Classi di corpi planetari

Skills: 5

[planetaryClasses.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/planetaryClasses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Composition, density and thermal history help explain why planets and moons display very different structures rather than simply different sizes.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta mondi rocciosi, pianeti giganti, lune e altri corpi planetari.

##### Pianeti giganti

[giantPlanets.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/giantPlanets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish gas giants from ice giants using composition, interior models and observable atmospheric properties.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui i giganti gassosi dai giganti ghiacciati in base alla composizione e alla struttura interna.

##### Satelliti naturali

[naturalSatellites.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/naturalSatellites.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare moons by origin, orbit, composition and geological activity without treating all satellites as Moon-like.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come le lune differiscono per dimensioni, origine, composizione e attività.

##### Densità e composizione planetaria

[planetaryDensityAndComposition.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/planetaryDensityAndComposition.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use mass, radius and density to constrain plausible bulk material and planetary classification.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa massa, dimensioni e densità di un mondo per ragionare sui materiali che lo compongono.

##### Sistemi di anelli planetari

[planetaryRingSystems.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/planetaryRingSystems.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the composition, dynamics, formation and evolution of rings around planets or other bodies, including interactions with nearby satellites and differences between dense rings and diffuse dust populations.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come gli anelli planetari si formano, cambiano e interagiscono con le lune vicine.

##### Pianeti terrestri

[terrestrialPlanets.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/planetaryClasses/skills/terrestrialPlanets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the characteristic rocky interiors, surfaces and atmospheres of Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora cosa rende Mercurio, Venere, Terra e Marte pianeti rocciosi con condizioni diverse.

#### Superfici e geologia

Skills: 4

[surfacesAndGeology.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/surfacesAndGeology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Observable terrain records impacts, deformation, volcanism and erosion, with interpretation conditioned by the limits of remote data.

**User-friendly description (it):** Interpreta gli indizi lasciati sulle superfici planetarie da collisioni e cambiamenti geologici.

##### Vulcanismo extraterrestre

[extraterrestrialVolcanism.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/skills/extraterrestrialVolcanism.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret evidence of past or current volcanic processes on planets and moons.

**User-friendly description (it):** Cerca i segni dell'attività vulcanica su mondi diversi dalla Terra.

[impactCratering.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/skills/impactCratering.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how collisions produce craters and why crater populations can reveal relative surface history.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come gli impatti creano crateri e cosa rivelano le loro distribuzioni.

##### Tettonica planetaria

[planetaryTectonics.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/skills/planetaryTectonics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare crustal deformation and tectonic regimes across worlds without assuming Earth-style plate tectonics everywhere.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta come le croste dei diversi mondi si piegano, si fratturano o si muovono.

[surfaceAgeEstimation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/planetaryScience/surfacesAndGeology/skills/surfaceAgeEstimation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use relative geologic relationships and calibrated crater statistics to infer the chronology of planetary surfaces.

**User-friendly description (it):** Stima quando si sono formate le superfici usando le relazioni geologiche e i crateri da impatto.

### Astronomia solare

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[solarAstronomy.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarAstronomy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Sun is examined as a physical star whose radiation, plasma and magnetism affect the Solar System. Stellar populations and the Sun's long-term evolutionary fate are treated in stellar astronomy.

**User-friendly description (it):** Studia il Sole come stella ed esplora come la sua energia e attività influenzano il Sistema solare.

#### Effetti eliosferici

Skills: 4

[heliosphericEffects.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/heliosphericEffects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Solar material and magnetic fields extend outward and can influence planetary space environments even far from the solar surface.

**User-friendly description (it):** Indaga come particelle e campi magnetici del Sole influenzano lo spazio circostante.

##### Processi delle aurore

[auroralProcesses.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/skills/auroralProcesses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how energetic charged particles interacting with an atmosphere and magnetic field produce auroral emissions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega come particelle cariche e gas atmosferici producono le aurore.

##### Eliosfera

[heliosphere.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/skills/heliosphere.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the region dominated by the solar wind and distinguish its boundary from a solid surface.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri l'enorme regione dello spazio influenzata dal vento solare.

##### Vento solare

[solarWind.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/skills/solarWind.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the outward flow of charged solar particles and their transport of magnetic fields through space.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora il flusso di particelle cariche che si propaga verso l'esterno dal Sole.

[spaceWeather.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/heliosphericEffects/skills/spaceWeather.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret solar-driven changes that can affect spacecraft, radio systems and near-Earth space without equating them with terrestrial weather.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come l'attività solare può disturbare le tecnologie spaziali e le comunicazioni.

#### Attività magnetica

Skills: 4

[magneticActivity.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/magneticActivity/magneticActivity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Magnetic fields in solar plasma produce time-variable surface features and energetic events rather than a perfectly steady star.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come i cambiamenti dei campi magnetici solari producono macchie ed eventi energetici.

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish large ejections of coronal plasma from flares, including their possible coincidence.

[solarActivityCycle.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/magneticActivity/skills/solarActivityCycle.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret periodic trends in solar magnetic activity without assuming identical cycles.

**User-friendly description (it):** Segui l'evoluzione dell'attività solare senza supporre che tutti i cicli siano identici.

[solarFlares.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/magneticActivity/skills/solarFlares.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe rapid magnetic-energy release and its observable radiation signatures.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come rapidi cambiamenti magnetici producono i brillamenti solari.

##### Macchie solari

[sunspots.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/magneticActivity/skills/sunspots.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the relation between dark solar surface regions, strong magnetic fields and relative temperature.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri perché le macchie solari appaiono più scure e come sono legate ai campi magnetici.

#### Struttura ed energia del Sole

Skills: 4

[solarStructureAndEnergy.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/solarStructureAndEnergy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Solar radiation originates from processes in the interior and travels outward through distinct plasma and atmospheric regions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come l'energia si trasferisce dalle profondità del Sole allo spazio circostante.

[solarAtmosphere.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/skills/solarAtmosphere.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the photosphere, chromosphere and corona by their observational features and physical conditions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci i diversi strati visibili ed esterni dell'atmosfera del Sole.

[solarInterior.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/skills/solarInterior.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the core, radiative zone and convective zone to the transport of energy through the Sun.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora gli strati interni del Sole e come trasportano energia.

[solarLuminosity.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/skills/solarLuminosity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the Sun's total radiant output and its relationship to illumination received at different distances.

[solarNuclearFusion.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarAstronomy/solarStructureAndEnergy/skills/solarNuclearFusion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how hydrogen fusion powers the Sun, distinguishing nuclear reactions from chemical combustion.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega perché il Sole è alimentato dalla fusione nucleare e non da una normale combustione.

### Struttura e origini del Sistema solare

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[solarSystemStructureAndOrigins.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Solar System is classified by its orbital organization and by evidence of formation from a common disk. Individual worlds are examined in planetary science, while the Sun's internal structure and activity belong to solar astronomy.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora la disposizione del Sistema solare e le prove della sua formazione.

Skills: 5

[formationAndChronology.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/formationAndChronology/formationAndChronology.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The formation model must explain both shared planetary characteristics and striking differences among observed worlds.

**User-friendly description (it):** Ricostruisci attraverso le prove come il Sistema solare è cresciuto e cambiato nel tempo.

[ageOfTheSolarSystem.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/formationAndChronology/skills/ageOfTheSolarSystem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret radiometric and meteoritic evidence used to constrain the time of Solar System formation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come meteoriti e datazione radioattiva aiutano a stimare l'età del Sistema solare.

[earlyDifferentiation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/formationAndChronology/skills/earlyDifferentiation.data.ts)

[planetaryAccretion.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/formationAndChronology/skills/planetaryAccretion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how collisions and gravitational growth build larger bodies from smaller solid material.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega come materiali più piccoli si uniscono formando corpi planetari più grandi.

##### Dischi protoplanetari

[protoplanetaryDisks.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/formationAndChronology/skills/protoplanetaryDisks.data.ts)

[minorBodies.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/minorBodies/minorBodies.data.ts)

[asteroids.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/minorBodies/skills/asteroids.data.ts)

[comets.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/minorBodies/skills/comets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the development of a coma and tails as volatile material responds to solar heating and the solar wind.

##### Meteoroidi, meteore e meteoriti

[meteoroidsMeteorsAndMeteorites.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/minorBodies/skills/meteoroidsMeteorsAndMeteorites.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a small body in space, its atmospheric luminous phenomenon and surviving material reaching the ground.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui un meteoroide nello spazio, una meteora nel cielo e un meteorite al suolo.

##### Oggetti transnettuniani

[transNeptunianObjects.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/minorBodies/skills/transNeptunianObjects.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify bodies beyond Neptune and relate their diverse orbits to the outer Solar System.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora la varietà degli oggetti che orbitano oltre Nettuno.

#### Struttura del sistema

Skills: 4

[systemArchitecture.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/systemArchitecture/systemArchitecture.data.ts)

[innerAndOuterSolarSystem.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/systemArchitecture/skills/innerAndOuterSolarSystem.data.ts)

[planetAndDwarfPlanetClassification.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/systemArchitecture/skills/planetAndDwarfPlanetClassification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply the physical and dynamical criteria that distinguish planets, dwarf planets and other orbiting bodies.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui i pianeti dai pianeti nani attraverso le loro caratteristiche fisiche e orbitali.

[smallBodyReservoirs.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/systemArchitecture/skills/smallBodyReservoirs.data.ts)

##### Componenti del Sistema solare

[solarSystemComponents.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/solarSystemStructureAndOrigins/systemArchitecture/skills/solarSystemComponents.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify the Sun, planets, natural satellites and smaller bodies by their roles in the system's gravitational architecture.

### Proprietà ed evoluzione stellare

Groups: 5 · Skills: 26

[stellarPropertiesAndEvolution.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution.data.ts)

[starFormation.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/starFormation.data.ts)

[molecularCloudCollapse.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/skills/molecularCloudCollapse.data.ts)

##### Protostelle

[protostars.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/skills/protostars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the stage during which a contracting young stellar object has not yet reached stable hydrogen fusion.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci la fase iniziale di una giovane stella prima che inizi una fusione stabile dell'idrogeno.

##### Dischi protostellari

[protostellarDisks.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/skills/protostellarDisks.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how circumstellar accretion disks transport matter and angular momentum during the early growth of stars.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come un disco di materia alimenta una stella in formazione.

##### Getti protostellari

[protostellarJets.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/starFormation/skills/protostellarJets.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the observed collimated outflows from young stellar systems and how their association with disks and magnetic fields constrains star-formation models.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri perché le stelle giovani possono emettere stretti getti di materia in movimento.

#### Classificazione stellare e substellare

Skills: 6

[stellarAndSubstellarClassification.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/stellarAndSubstellarClassification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Spectra, temperature, luminosity, mass, multiplicity and composition provide complementary ways to group luminous stars and related substellar bodies, while observational class need not imply a unique evolutionary history.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora diversi tipi di stelle e oggetti affini attraverso spettri, massa e luminosità.

##### Stelle binarie e multiple

[binaryAndMultipleStars.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/binaryAndMultipleStars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how gravitationally bound stellar systems are identified and used to estimate stellar properties.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come coppie e gruppi di stelle orbitano gli uni intorno agli altri.

##### Nane brune

[brownDwarfs.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/brownDwarfs.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish substellar objects below the sustained hydrogen-fusion threshold from stars, including their cooling, atmospheric spectra and uncertain classification near planetary masses.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come le nane brune si distinguono dalle stelle e dagli oggetti di massa planetaria.

##### Diagramma di Hertzsprung–Russell

[hertzsprungRussellDiagram.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/hertzsprungRussellDiagram.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the distribution of stars by luminosity and temperature and identify major evolutionary regions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Leggi un diagramma di Hertzsprung–Russell per confrontare temperature, luminosità e fasi evolutive delle stelle.

##### Popolazioni stellari

[stellarPopulations.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/stellarPopulations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish stellar populations by typical ages, chemical abundances and locations without treating the categories as absolute.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta popolazioni di stelle con età, composizioni e posizioni differenti.

##### Tipi spettrali stellari

[stellarSpectralTypes.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/stellarSpectralTypes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify stars by temperature-sensitive spectral characteristics rather than by color alone.

**User-friendly description (it):** Identifica le classi spettrali delle stelle attraverso le caratteristiche della loro luce.

##### Stelle variabili

[variableStars.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarAndSubstellarClassification/skills/variableStars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify intrinsic stellar brightness variation by physical mechanism, timescale or periodicity, distinguishing it from apparent variation caused by eclipsing companions.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le diverse cause dei cambiamenti di luminosità delle stelle.

#### Evoluzione stellare

Skills: 5

[stellarEvolution.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/stellarEvolution.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Mass and composition strongly constrain the duration and physical stages of a star's nuclear-burning lifetime.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come cambiano le stelle man mano che consumano il loro combustibile nucleare.

##### Fusione nucleare nelle fasi stellari avanzate

[advancedStellarFusion.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/advancedStellarFusion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how later nuclear-burning stages depend on stellar mass and can create heavier nuclei.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come alcune stelle fondono elementi più pesanti nelle ultime fasi della loro vita.

##### Sequenza principale

[mainSequence.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/mainSequence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why stars can remain in a long-lived core hydrogen-burning state and why mass changes its duration.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega perché le stelle trascorrono gran parte della loro vita fondendo idrogeno nel nucleo.

##### Giganti rosse

[redGiants.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/redGiants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the expansion and cooling of stellar envelopes during post-main-sequence evolution and distinguish the relevant evolutionary paths by progenitor mass.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come le stelle si espandono e si raffreddano diventando giganti rosse.

##### Durata della vita delle stelle

[stellarLifetimes.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/stellarLifetimes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare the evolutionary timescales of stars with different initial masses.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta quanto a lungo vivono le stelle in base alla loro massa iniziale.

##### Supergiganti

[supergiants.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarEvolution/skills/supergiants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the very large sizes and high luminosities of massive evolved stars and their connection to advanced stellar evolution and mass loss.

**User-friendly description (it):** Riconosci le dimensioni e la luminosità enormi delle stelle massicce evolute.

#### Proprietà stellari

Skills: 5

[stellarProperties.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/stellarProperties.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Observed spectra and brightness are combined with models to infer physical characteristics that cannot be measured by direct sampling.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come gli astronomi misurano e ricavano le proprietà fisiche delle stelle.

##### Equilibrio idrostatico stellare

[stellarHydrostaticEquilibrium.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarHydrostaticEquilibrium.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how the balance of inward gravitational forces and outward pressure gradients sustains an approximately stable star and how disruption of the balance causes structural changes.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come gravità e pressione interna mantengono una stella in equilibrio.

##### Luminosità stellare

[stellarLuminosity.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarLuminosity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish total emitted power from the light received by an observer and infer luminosity from suitable measurements.

**User-friendly description (it):** Distingui la quantità di energia emessa da una stella da quanto luminosa appare dalla Terra.

##### Massa stellare

[stellarMass.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarMass.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine or constrain stellar mass from orbital dynamics or other model-dependent observations.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa misurazioni orbitali e modelli per stimare la massa di una stella.

##### Raggio stellare

[stellarRadius.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarRadius.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer a star's size from luminosity, temperature, eclipses or other relevant evidence.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come gli astronomi ricavano il raggio di una stella dalla sua luce e da altre osservazioni.

##### Temperatura stellare

[stellarTemperature.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarProperties/skills/stellarTemperature.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how stellar spectra and emitted energy distributions constrain effective temperature.

**User-friendly description (it):** Usa i colori e le caratteristiche della luce stellare per studiare la temperatura.

#### Resti stellari

Skills: 6

[stellarRemnants.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/stellarRemnants.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The final states of stars differ according to progenitor mass, mass loss and binary interactions; extreme events redistribute energy and elements.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora i resti compatti e le fasi finali esplosive dei diversi tipi di stelle.

##### Arricchimento chimico del cosmo

[cosmicElementEnrichment.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/cosmicElementEnrichment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how stellar nucleosynthesis and explosive or ejective events change the chemical composition of surrounding space.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come le stelle e le esplosioni stellari diffondono elementi nello spazio circostante.

##### Stelle di neutroni

[neutronStars.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/neutronStars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the physical properties and formation of ultra-compact neutron-rich remnants supported by dense matter, including limits imposed by mass and rotation.

**User-friendly description (it):** Scopri come il collasso dei nuclei stellari può formare stelle di neutroni.

##### Pulsar

[pulsars.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/pulsars.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret periodic electromagnetic pulses as beams from rotating magnetized neutron stars and distinguish an observational pulsar designation from a separate stellar-remnant type.

**User-friendly description (it):** Spiega perché le stelle di neutroni in rotazione possono produrre impulsi regolari di radiazione.

##### Buchi neri di massa stellare

[stellarMassBlackHoles.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/stellarMassBlackHoles.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the formation and observational inference of compact remnants with event horizons.

**User-friendly description (it):** Esplora come si formano i buchi neri di massa stellare e come gli astronomi ne rilevano gli effetti.

##### Supernove

[supernovae.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/supernovae.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish major physical mechanisms that produce stellar explosions and interpret their observational signatures.

**User-friendly description (it):** Confronta i diversi processi che producono le esplosioni delle supernove.

##### Nane bianche

[whiteDwarfs.data.ts](../../../content/astronomy/data/skills/stellarPropertiesAndEvolution/stellarRemnants/skills/whiteDwarfs.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a compact electron-degeneracy-supported remnant forms after some stars shed their outer layers.

**User-friendly description (it):** Comprendi come alcune stelle lasciano dietro di sé dense nane bianche.
